publication: George F. McNulty, Elementary Model Theory, MATH 762, University of South Carolina, Fall 2011. 113-page author-hosted PDF; printed p. + 4 = one-based PDF page for the inspected main text.

reviews.checked_passages: Section 8.3 printed pp.88–89: order indiscernibles, the Ramsey/compactness existence proof, and iterative Skolemization. The modesty theorem and its type-counting proof on pp.89–90 were inspected only for the scope boundary and are not adopted.
reviews.consumers: [Indiscernible sequences](entries/indiscernible-sequences/entry.html) and [Models generated by indiscernibles](entries/ehrenfeucht-mostowski-models/entry.html); the corpus expands the finite-fragment and term-map arguments.
reviews.outcome: MCNULTY-MT-01 records a local wrong indexing set for the distinctness axioms. The corpus uses constants indexed by the ordered set, homogeneous restrictions for each of finitely many relevant arities, and an explicit fully Skolemized expansion before taking an elementary generated hull. No global classification or modesty result is certified by this inspection.
